model: Stage 6 V2 two-state, single scalar sensor; no trigger/monitor/likelihood changes
attack_model: one onset k and one fixed b in [0, 0.25], injected at trusted sends
replay_stage: Stage 6 final only; all 12 saved episodes per b; same three RNG streams and final seeds
certificate_evidence: replay every successful saved Stage 6 certificate query; failed queries leave the outer set unchanged
parameter_outer_set: per-onset b interval intersected with every successful directional certificate; unit response H is outward-Decimal interval
response_arithmetic: exact rational Riccati matrices plus Stage 4 directed Decimal interval arithmetic (50-digit precision)
direction_transport: adjoint transport under exact F with support recomputed over the fixed-amplitude outer set
legacy_fallback: if interval support does not certify at least the old action guarantee, retain the old valid action
metrics: G_cert squared action norm lower bound
reason: This stage first isolates propagation on identical archived final traces; it does not count saved certificate search cost or claim independent performance confirmation.
